     1	# Shared Circuit Understanding Document (SCUD): communication-bridge
     2	
     3	## 1. Module Overview & System Context
     4	The `communication-bridge` module is a singleton component within the stackable-BMS system, acting as the primary gateway between the Low-Voltage (LV) control domain and the High-Voltage (HV) battery sensing domain. Its core function is to translate standard microcontroller communication protocols (UART or SPI) into the robust, isolated differential daisy chain signals required by the `bms-monitor-module` (BQ79616-Q1). 
     5	
     6	The module is based on the **BQ79600-Q1** Bridge IC. It resides on the isolation boundary, ensuring galvanic protection for the logic board while enabling bi-directional data flow, system wake-up, and fault signaling.
     7	
     8	**Key Interfaces:**
     9	- **Host Side (Cold):** Connects to the `microcontroller-module` via SPI (default) or UART, NFAULT, and INH signals. Powered by 12V (BAT) and 3.3V/5V (VIO) from the `low-voltage-power-supply`.
    10	- **Daisy Chain Side (Hot):** Connects to the first `bms-monitor-module` in the stack via an isolated differential pair (COMHP/COMHN). Supports an optional ring architecture via COMLP/COMLN.
    11	
    12	## 2. Architectural Deviations (Baseline vs. Target)
    13	The design is adapted from the BQ79600EVM evaluation board to meet the specific requirements of the `communication-bridge` module.
    14	
    15	**Removed components/blocks:**
    16	- **Evaluation Headers (J1, J3, J5):** Removed and replaced with system-integrated signal routing.
    17	- **Test Points:** Pruned for production-focused design.
    18	- **Mode Selection Switch (S1):** Replaced with fixed hardware strapping for SPI mode.
    19	- **On-board LDOs (if any):** Module relies on system-provided BAT (12V) and VIO (3.3V/5V) rails.
    20	
    21	**Added components/blocks:**
    22	- **High-Voltage Isolation Barrier:** Implementation of high-voltage transformers (T1) on both COMH and COML ports to satisfy the 1000V DC isolation requirement.
    23	- **Termination and Filtering:** Specific RC termination network on COM lines for signal integrity in a multi-node daisy chain.
    24	- **INH Signal Path:** Explicitly routed to support system-level PMIC/regulator wake-up functionality as per boundary requirements.
    25	
    26	## 3. Components Inventory
    27	Final synthesized component list derived from BQ79600EVM baseline and boundary requirements:
    28	
    29	| Component | RefDes | Value / Part Number | Description |
    30	|:---|:---|:---|:---|
    31	| **Bridge ASIC** | U4 | BQ79600-Q1 | Power-on communications bridge, TSSOP-16 |
    32	| **Isolation Transformer** | T1, T2 | TDK ALT4532 or equiv | Dual-channel pulse transformer for COMH/COML isolation |
    33	| **BAT Bypass Cap** | C27 | 0.1uF / 50V | Decoupling for 12V supply |
    34	| **VIO Bypass Cap** | C24 | 0.1uF / 10V | Decoupling for logic IO supply |
    35	| **CVDD Capacitor** | C25 | 1uF / 16V | Internal 5V LDO output capacitor (Hot side reference) |
    36	| **DVDD Capacitor** | C26 | 1uF / 10V | Internal 1.8V LDO output capacitor (Digital core) |
    37	| **AVDD Capacitor** | C28 | 1uF / 10V | Analog core supply capacitor |
    38	| **Termination Resistors**| R40, R41 | 100 Ohm | Differential pair termination on isolated side |
    39	| **Isolation Caps** | C33-C36 | 1000pF / 2kV | High-voltage AC-coupling/protection capacitors |
    40	| **Series Resistors** | R33-R36 | 22 Ohm | Dampening resistors on SPI/UART host interface |
    41	| **INH Pull-down** | R37 | 100k Ohm | Default state for INH signal |
    42	| **High Voltage Capacitor** | C33-C36 | 1000pF / 2kV | 1808 or 1812 package |
    43	
    44	## Library Mapping
    45	
    46	| Component Name | Imported Component Name | Status |
    47	|---|---|---|
    48	| BQ79600-Q1 | BQ79600PWRQ1 | imported |
    49	| TDK ALT4532 | ALT4532M-171-T001 | imported |
    50	| 1000pF / 2kV Cap | PS102J3F1504 | imported |
    51	
    52	## 4. Connectivity & Signal Flow
    53	**Host Interface (Cold Side):**
    54	- **MOSI/MISO/SCLK/nCS:** Standard SPI interface to the MCU. nUART/SPI pin is tied to GND to select SPI mode.
    55	- **NFAULT:** Open-drain output connected to the MCU with an external 10k pull-up (on MCU board or locally).
    56	- **INH:** High-voltage output (sourced from BAT) used to signal system wake-up to the PMIC.
    57	- **DVDD:** 1.8V rail available at P2.11 for monitoring or internal logic reference.
    58	
    59	**Isolated Interface (Hot Side):**
    60	- **COMHP/N:** Transmitted/Received differential signals pass through series isolation capacitors (C33/34) and then through the Isolation Transformer (T1) to the P1.1 port.
    61	- **COMLP/N:** Secondary daisy chain interface for ring topology, isolated via T2 and capacitors C35/36 to P1.2 port.
    62	- **CVDD:** 5V rail provided at P1.3 for daisy chain biasing or sensing as needed by the monitor modules.
    63	
    64	**Signal Flow:**
    65	- `MCU SPI` -> `U4 SPI Interface` -> `Protocol Engine` -> `COMH Differential Driver` -> `Isolation Barrier` -> `Daisy Chain`.
    66	
    67	## 5. Uncertainties, Assumptions & Confidence
    68	- **Assumption:** SPI mode is selected as the primary host interface for the 12MHz throughput capability mentioned in the boundary doc.
    69	- **Assumption:** 1000V DC isolation is achieved via the combination of 2kV rated capacitors and a transformer with 1.5kV+ dielectric strength.
    70	- **Constraint Compliance:** The design supports the 1Mbps UART or 12MHz SPI requirements.
    71	- **Confidence:** High for circuit topology and core component values. Medium for specific part numbers of transformers (T1/T2) as they depend on the final choice of cabling and EMC requirements.
